title: Identifying Time Preference Shocks: Stated and Revealed Preferences after an Italian Earthquake
abstract: arXiv:2611.19662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Identifying time preference shocks is challenging: shocks large enough to shift survey-elicited stated impatience also tighten financial resources, confounding the interpretation of stated time preference. Jointly examining stated and revealed preferences resolves this identification problem: impatience shocks and reductions in financial resources generate opposite consumption responses, even though both raise stated impatience. Applying our identification framework to the 2009 L'Aquila earthquake, we combine panel data with spatially granular seismic and damage data in a difference-in-differences design that compares undamaged households that experienced the earthquake with a spatial control group at similar distances from the epicenter. Treated households report greater impatience and increase nondurable consumption by 11 percent relative to controls. translated_title: 识别时间偏好冲击：意大利地震后的陈述偏好与显示偏好
translated_abstract: 识别时间偏好冲击面临挑战：足以改变调查所得陈述性不耐烦程度的大冲击，同时也会收紧财务资源，从而混淆了对陈述性时间偏好的解读。联合考察陈述偏好与显示偏好可以解决这一识别问题：不耐烦冲击与财务资源减少会产生相反的消费反应，尽管两者都会提高陈述的不耐烦程度。我们将该识别框架应用于2009年拉奎拉地震，将面板数据与空间上精细的地震及损失数据相结合，采用双重差分设计，将经历地震但未受损的家庭与距震中距离相近的空间对照组进行比较。受影响的家庭报告了更强的不耐烦，且相对于对照组其非耐用品消费增加了11%。这些效应与心理压力渠道相一致，集中于受影响最……（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出通过联合考察陈述偏好与显示偏好来识别时间偏好冲击，并将其应用于2009年拉奎拉地震，发现经历地震但未受损的家庭表现出更强的陈述性不耐烦且非耐用品消费增加11%，其效应符合心理压力渠道机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes identifying time preference shocks by jointly examining stated and revealed preferences, applying the framework to the 2009 L'Aquila earthquake and finding that unaffected households exposed to the quake report greater impatience and increase nondurable consumption by 11 percent, consistent with a psychological stress channel.
